headings.strategy: Clean, modern, avoid giant headings. Max text-3xl for main screens.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use heavily on the floating Guardian pill and bottom sheet handles. backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-900/70 with a 1px border-zinc-800.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for floating elements, no harsh drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.radii: Rounded-2xl for bottom sheets (Android bottom sheet native feel), rounded-full for pills and floating action buttons.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #27272a (zinc-800) for subtle separation. Avoid thick borders.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise on main background if possible, otherwise clean dark flats.

layouts.app_container: Mobile-first width constraint. max-w-md mx-auto h-screen relative overflow-hidden bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-50.
layouts.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom navigation bar, glassmorphic or solid surface, 4 items: Home, EA FC, Protection, Profile.
layouts.ea_fc_mock_view: Full screen beneath the Guardian UI. Use the soccer field background. Darkened with a scrim.
layouts.guardian_pill: Floating absolute bottom-24 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-40. Glassmorphic pill.
layouts.bottom_sheet: Framer motion AnimatePresence. Slides up from bottom. rounded-t-3xl. Max height 85vh, internal scroll.

components.StatusPill: Small rounded-full badge showing connection/protection state. Green dot + text.
components.PlayerReviewCard: Horizontal layout: Player image (left), Name + Rating (center), Icon explanation (right). bg-zinc-900 rounded-xl p-3.
components.PresetCard: Selectable card for protection presets. When selected, add a subtle mint border or soft animated glow.
components.ExplanationSheet: Contextual bottom sheet with an icon (Info/Shield/Warning), title, and human-readable text.
components.SubmitButton: Full width, h-14, danger color or primary color depending on context. Press state scale 0.98.

motion.bottomSheet: y: '100%' to y: 0. transition: { type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 200 }
motion.stagedLoading: Fade in/out for steps: 'SBC detected' -> 'Analyzing club' -> 'Solution found'.

media.icons_usage: ShieldCheck (Protection), Info (Context), Warning (Risk), User (Profile), House (Home), SoccerBall (EA FC)

soccer_field_bg.description: Mocked underlying EA FC app scenery (dark soccer field top view).

player_portrait_1.description: Mood player portrait for solution preview.

player_portrait_2.description: Focused player portrait for solution preview.

abstract_texture.description: Subtle abstract dark jade wave texture for premium header cards (e.g. Protection Active card).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure soft off-white text (#f4f4f5) against #09090b passes APCA.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings should use primary #10b981 color.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements (buttons, pill, nav items).
accessibility.screen_readers: Include aria-labels for the floating pill and icon-only buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a mobile-web prototype. Restrict the main container to `max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh]` to simulate a phone screen.
Implement a Bottom Navigation bar with 4 tabs: Home, EA FC, Protection, Profile.
The 'EA FC' tab should display the mocked field background and a floating 'Guardian Pill' at the bottom. Clicking it opens the main flow Bottom Sheet.
Implement the Bottom Sheet using Framer Motion (slide up from bottom). Avoid Shadcn dialog for this, or heavily customize it to be a real bottom sheet.
Within the Bottom Sheet flow, mock a staged loading: 'Detecting SBC...' -> 'Scanning Club...' -> 'Solution Ready'.
The Solution screen should have a prominent 'Apply Squad' button. Show protected players clearly with the ShieldCheck icon.
The 'Submit' flow requires a destructive confirmation dialog (red accents, warning icons).
The 'Protection' tab should list presets (Relaxed, Recommended, Very Safe, Custom) using selectable cards.
DO NOT use generic centered web layouts. This must feel like a native Android app.
Every interactive element MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Follow the color palette strictly: deep graphite background, jade green accents, amber warnings. No excessive neon glows.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Do not apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
Do not center align the app container in global CSS.
Never use placeholder text for images; use the provided image URLs.
